audit.whatIsWrong: Four places say Blinding Dart turns off your autos AND your 'Q wind-up' / tornado.
audit.why: Blind stops basic attacks and the on-hit riding them; Steel Tempest still deals its damage. The mirror audit's headline finding cites the wiki's Steel Tempest interaction list — 'Blind: both first target and secondary target do take damage' — and found the Teemo-side entry built on the opposite assumption in four places.
audit.corrected: Keep casting Steel Tempest through the blind; only your autos are off.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wind Wall versus Noxious Trap is never mentioned.
audit.why: Noxious Trap carries the projectile flag — the thrown mushroom is blockable. That matters most in the exact moment the page warns about: a shroom landing in your dash path.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall blocks a thrown mushroom as well as the dart; you get one of the two per 25s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere (packet flags this as a defect).
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank — it does not shorten as he levels it, so the trade window is fixed all lane. Move Quick 14s, Wind Wall 25s at rank 1 down to 17s.
audit.corrected: Flat 7s dart and 14s Move Quick written into the spikes and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Teemo five of seven rows, including 2+ items, against a 56.31% Yasuo win rate — the packet flags exactly this.
audit.why: The whys and spikes both say the late game is yours: Teemo is a squishy immobile carry once you close. Level 6 is genuinely contested rather than his, since his ultimate is zoning, not a duel tool.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Skill, 2+ items to Yasuo, as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags Toxic Shot as on-hit magic damage that scales with attack speed, so armour reads the trade wrong. The entry already builds MR and Mercury's Treads, which is the right answer.

edits.before: Teemo owns this window: Blinding Dart (Q) turns off your autos and Q-tornado wind-up, and his auto-attack range plus Move Quick (W) lets him kite your E-Q and poison-tick you down. Save Wind Wall for his Q — a blinded Yasuo can't trade — and just farm safely rather than force a losing all-in.
edits.after: Teemo owns this window: Blinding Dart (Q, a flat 7s) turns off your autos and the on-hit riding them, but NOT Steel Tempest — the tornado still damages him, so keep casting Q while blinded. His 680 range and Move Quick (W, 14s) still kite your E-Q, so wall the dart and farm safe.

edits.before: Still Teemo-favoured in lane: his blind uptime and Noxious Trap (R) shroom zoning make committing risky, and a shroom in your dash path can flip an engage. Your R needs a knock-up he denies by kiting, so don't force it — the winning play here is to shove and roam, where your kit outshines his.
edits.after: Still Teemo-favoured in lane: his blind uptime and Noxious Trap (R) shrooms zone your dash paths, and Wind Wall blocks a thrown mushroom, so keep the wall for the one aimed at your feet. Last Breath needs your own Q2 knockup — he gives you none — so shove and roam instead of forcing it.

edits.before: You take over late — this is your phase. Teemo is a squishy, immobile AP carry, so Windwall his blind, E-dash onto him, and your crit R combo deletes him before he kites away. Sweep his shrooms in fights, close the gap once, and he has no escape or peel.
edits.after: You take over late — this is your phase. Teemo is a squishy, immobile AP carry, so Wind Wall the dart, E-dash onto him, and your crit R combo deletes him before he kites away. Sweep his shrooms, close once, and remember the blind never stops Steel Tempest.

notes: The Wind-Wall-blocks-mushroom point rests on the kit file's projectile flag on Noxious Trap plus the mirror's wiki check; I rated it Medium rather than High because Riot's own text does not describe the throw as a missile. Also worth a human decision: diffRating stays 8.5/10 while Yasuo wins 56.31% of these games — the lane phase really is his, but 'hard matchup' plus a 56% win rate is a mixed message on the page.
